grammar_title: 非限制性定语从句(which/who/whose · 介词+which/whom · 指代整句的 which)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修一 Unit 1 Using language:非限制性定语从句。句子地道、幽默主题、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项);非限制性从句前有逗号,that 不能引导。

points.point: 非限制性 who / which(逗号+补充信息;指人 who、指物 which,that 不可用)
points.overview: 先行词后有逗号、从句提供额外(可省去)信息时,指人用 who、指物 which;非限制性从句绝不用 that;从句缺主语/宾语时不用 where/when。

points.point: 非限制性 whose · 介词+which/whom(of which / of whom / in/for + whom)
points.overview: whose+名词表所属;介词后指物用 which、指人用 whom(some of which / many of whom / for whom);介词后不可用 that,也不用 where。

points.point: which 指代整个主句(…, which …,that 不能引导非限制性从句)
points.overview: 逗号后的 which 可指代前面整句话,在从句中作主语/宾语;that/what/it 都不能这样引导非限制性从句。

questions.stem: My uncle, ____ tells jokes all day, used to work as a circus clown.
questions.explanation: 逗号补充信息、先行词 uncle 指人且从句缺主语 → who;非限制性不用 that,whom 需作宾语。

questions.stem: The clown doctor, ____ wears a bright red nose, makes sick children laugh.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人、从句缺主语 → who;where 不能作主语,that 不引导非限制性。

questions.stem: Lara, ____ had hurt her ankle, soon began to smile again.
questions.explanation: 先行词为人名、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The old magazines, ____ had been read hundreds of times, lay on the chairs.
questions.explanation: 先行词 magazines 指物、从句缺主语 → which;非限制性不用 that。

questions.stem: Mark Twain, ____ was an American writer, was famous for his quick wit.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: His curly wig, ____ is bright and colourful, makes the children giggle.
questions.explanation: 先行词 wig 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The on-duty nurse, ____ knew Lara well, told the clown her story.
questions.explanation: 先行词 nurse 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: Lin Yutang, ____ brought humour to Chinese literature, was a famous writer.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The hospital waiting room, ____ felt full of tension, was a rather sad place.
questions.explanation: 先行词 room 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: Charlie Chaplin, ____ made silent films, could make people laugh without words.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The funny scene, ____ takes place in a factory, always makes me laugh.
questions.explanation: 先行词 scene 指物、从句缺主语 → which;where 不能作主语。

questions.stem: Doctor Larry, ____ paints a big smile on his face, visits the children every week.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The magic trick, ____ surprised the little girl, made her laugh out loud.
questions.explanation: 先行词 trick 指物、从句缺主语 → which;非限制性不用 that。

questions.stem: My grandfather, ____ loves a good joke, often makes the whole family laugh.
questions.explanation: 先行词指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The silly story, ____ had a clever ending, cheered everyone up.
questions.explanation: 先行词 story 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The two kind doctors, ____ treated Lara's ankle, also enjoyed the clown's show.
questions.explanation: 先行词 doctors 指人、从句缺主语 → who;whom 需作宾语。

questions.stem: Humour, ____ is found in every culture, brings people closer together.
questions.explanation: 先行词 humour 指物(抽象)、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The class teacher, ____ rarely laughs at anything, finally cracked a smile.
questions.explanation: 先行词 teacher 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The big red nose, ____ sits in the middle of his face, is the funniest part.
questions.explanation: 先行词 nose 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: Lin's quick wit, ____ saved him at the dinner, made everyone admire him.
questions.explanation: 先行词 wit 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The little girl, ____ ankle was badly hurt, would not stop crying.
questions.explanation: ankle 属于 girl,表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: Mark Twain, ____ books are still loved today, was a master of wit.
questions.explanation: books 属于 Twain → whose。

questions.stem: The clown, ____ red nose had fallen off, quickly picked it up again.
questions.explanation: red nose 属于 clown → whose。

questions.stem: Lin Yutang, ____ humour was always gentle, made the president laugh.
questions.explanation: humour 属于 Lin → whose。

questions.stem: The young patient, ____ smile returned at last, thanked the clown doctor.
questions.explanation: smile 属于 patient → whose。

questions.stem: Charlie Chaplin, ____ most famous character is the Tramp, never spoke on screen.
questions.explanation: character 属于 Chaplin → whose。

questions.stem: The Roman emperor, ____ wild animals all walked away, was completely astonished.
questions.explanation: animals 属于 emperor → whose。

questions.stem: The comedian, ____ jokes are always clean and kind, is loved by children.
questions.explanation: jokes 属于 comedian → whose。

questions.stem: My best friend, ____ sense of humour is wonderful, can always make me laugh.
questions.explanation: sense of humour 属于 friend → whose。

questions.stem: The busy hospital, ____ staff work very hard, warmly welcomes the clown doctors.
questions.explanation: staff 属于 hospital → whose。

questions.stem: He looked through the old magazines, all of ____ had been read many times before.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指物 → of which;magazines 是物。

questions.stem: The clown doctors, many of ____ once trained as actors, also learn medical skills.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指人 → of whom;clown doctors 是人。

questions.stem: On a typical day they meet many patients, some of ____ are very young.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指人 → some of whom。

questions.stem: He tried several jokes, none of ____ made the frightened boy laugh.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指物 → none of which;jokes 是物。

questions.stem: The doctor used a special medicine, the effect of ____ surprised everyone.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指物 → the effect of which。

questions.stem: Lin met two professors, both of ____ enjoyed his witty little story.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指人 → both of whom。

questions.stem: The large audience, in front of ____ Lin stood, waited for his speech.
questions.explanation: 介词 in front of 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: She told a long story, the ending of ____ made the whole class roar.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指物 → the ending of which。

questions.stem: The kind nurses keep us updated, for ____ we are all very grateful.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后指人 → for whom。

questions.stem: He kept several red noses, one of ____ was far bigger than the others.
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后指物 → one of which;noses 是物。

questions.stem: Laughter produces helpful chemicals, ____ means clown doctors can really help.
questions.explanation: 逗号后指代前面整句话、作从句主语 → which;that/what/it 都不能引导非限制性从句。

questions.stem: He produced her sock from his pocket, ____ made the little girl laugh.
questions.explanation: which 指代整件事、作主语;that 不引导非限制性从句。

questions.stem: The clown sang and danced, ____ cheered up the whole ward.
questions.explanation: which 指代前面整句;this/that 都不能引导从句。

questions.stem: Twain replied with a witty remark, ____ completely surprised the barber.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语;非限制性不用 that。

questions.stem: Lin told a short joke, ____ made his whole audience roar with laughter.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语。

questions.stem: The doctors did a great job, ____ made Lara's parents feel relieved.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语;it 会造成无连词的并列句。

questions.stem: The children kept laughing, ____ showed the magic medicine had worked.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语。

questions.stem: He forgot all his lines on stage, ____ made the whole class laugh.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语;that 不引导非限制性从句。

questions.stem: Chaplin never spoke in his films, ____ made his clever acting even funnier.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语。

questions.stem: She finally cracked a smile, ____ pleased her tired and worried parents.
questions.explanation: which 指代整件事、作主语。

questions.stem: Their tent had been stolen, ____ Holmes had completely failed to notice.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作 notice 的宾语;that/what 不引导非限制性从句。

questions.stem: Humour brings people together, ____ is one reason we need it so much.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语。

questions.stem: The clown pretended to trip over a chair, ____ made the children giggle.
questions.explanation: which 指代整件事、作主语。

questions.stem: Twain often made witty remarks, ____ won him fame far beyond America.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语。

questions.stem: The nurse kept us updated, ____ helped us care for each patient better.
questions.explanation: which 指代整件事、作主语。

questions.stem: He put on his wig and red nose, ____ instantly changed him into a clown.
questions.explanation: which 指代整件事、作主语。

questions.stem: Lara stopped crying at last, ____ was exactly what the clown had hoped for.
questions.explanation: which 指代整件事、作主语。

questions.stem: The whole audience laughed loudly, ____ greatly encouraged the young comedian.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语。

questions.stem: Lin gently told off the president, ____ nobody had expected him to do.
questions.explanation: which 指代前面的行为、作 do 的宾语;that/what 不引导非限制性从句。

questions.stem: Good humour can lighten hard times, ____ is why people value it so highly.
questions.explanation: which 指代整句、作主语。
